note: The Oakhaven scrapbook: every camera roll from every mission. Newest first. Each photo lives in scrapbook/<id>-<n>.jpg (1080x1350) with a 432x540 copy in scrapbook/thumbs/. 'who' lists the survivors in a photo; a photo without 'who' counts everyone in the roll's crew.

rolls.intro: Jack had the camera today. Three of us walked out there with zero rounds.
rolls.outro: We came home with 3 guns, 4 blades and axes, 60 rounds, and two sets of cracked ribs.

photos.note: Sam and Gabe on the forest road. Nobody had been out here since it started.
The gun locker was padlocked. Sam's crowbar, Gabe's flashlight.
Three guns, blades, axes, and 60 rounds. Jack went straight for the rifle.
Then the door opened. One of the big ones, all the way from the docks.
Sam's machete and Gabe's hatchet put it down. Gabe taped Sam up first, then himself.
The long walk home. Nobody talked.

rolls.intro: Francis found a camera at Pier 9 today. He spent the rest of the day testing it on us.
rolls.outro: Nobody would look at the camera. Out here you don't want to be remembered.

photos.note: Adam trying to bring the generator back. Still no gas.
Tanny wiring today's car doors into the fence. We had company.
Mateen's garden on the roof. Jaylozy on watch.
Victoria making supper. Asa didn't leave that chair all night.
Seth on the radio after dark. Nothing but static.

rolls.intro: Sam, Jeremy and Jaylozy cleared the Pier 9 warehouse.
rolls.outro: 32 rations of food, a crate of bayonets, and 6 of our last 8 rounds gone.

photos.note: Walking in. Something already standing in the loading door.
32 rations of food in one crate.
Jeremy found these. He kept one.
Six of our last eight rounds.
